name: DupZap
author: TAKAHIRO

sections.description:
DupZap makes duplicating content in WordPress simple and efficient. Whether you’re a blogger, designer, or developer, this plugin helps you quickly duplicate posts, pages, or custom post types with just one click.

Lightweight and fully compatible with the WordPress admin UI, DupZap adds a “Clone” link to each post/page list for instant duplication.

Features

  • Duplicate any post, page, or custom post type
  • Copies title, content, excerpt, taxonomies, featured image, and meta fields
  • Fast and intuitive integration into WordPress admin interface
  • No settings required — just activate and go
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dupzap folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the posts or pages list and click the “Clone” link under the item you want to duplicate.
sections.faq:
Does DupZap support custom post types?

Yes. Any public post type will include a “Clone” link automatically.

What data is copied when duplicating?

The plugin copies the post title, content, excerpt, author, featured image, taxonomies (categories/tags), and all custom fields.

Is there a settings page?

No settings required. DupZap works out of the box.
